warnings: Fluoride is tracked as a soft ceiling, not a goal; there is no 'low fluoride' warning.
ICMR-NIN 2020 fluoride values were not found; NIH AI (4 mg men, 3 mg women) and UL 10 mg are secondary, unverified.
IFCT 2017 has no fluoride data; the app cannot estimate fluoride from dishes.
Drinking water above 1.5 mg/L (BIS permissible limit) should be treated (RO, Nalgonda, activated alumina) or replaced; boiling does not remove fluoride and can concentrate it.
Children under 6: pea-size toothpaste only, with supervision; no supplements without a doctor or dentist.
Kidney disease, pregnancy and breastfeeding: show only general information plus 'Follow your doctor's advice'.
Fluorosis (tooth mottling, joint stiffness) is generally not reversible: see a doctor or dentist.
